messages:
infra-alert-bot: ALERT P1 — spike in 5xx on prod us-east-1 for text-generation models. Paging oncall @maria-s and SRE rotation. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/ingest/abcd. Autoscale/kv-cache errors observed.

sre_pager: Pager acknowledged. Notifying oncall and starting warroom.

maria-s: oncall here — acked pager. Joining warroom: https://meet.redwood/warrooms/1754321000 (created). I'll start triage.

ben-engineer: grabbing runbook now. Quick checklist: kvcache throttle, kernel selection, gateway queue depth. If kvcache appears saturated, fallback to smaller kv shard.

sam-product: any early signal on customer impact? Should we prepare a status page blurb + customer notif?

maria-s: initial triage: ~15% 5xx on gen path for long-context models (>=2048). Elevated latency spikes as well. Impact appears to be partial region degradation — 10% of requests failing, mostly chat flows. No data loss detected.

ben-engineer: assigning mitigations: I'll attempt kernel rollback (kvcache-v2 -> kvcache-v1) on a canary host, then roll. @maria-s will trigger traffic reroute if errors persist.

infra-deploy-bot: deploy: rollback job started by ben-engineer. Job id: deploy-1754321. Logs: https://redwood.internal/deploys/deploy-1754321

maria-s: draft status page: "We are investigating increased 500 errors for text-generation in us-east-1. Some customers may experience failed requests or delayed responses. Engineers are actively mitigating; next update in 15 minutes." Thoughts? :warning:

sam-product: LGTM. Add estimated affected percent (approx ~10%) and note no data loss. I'll prepare customer email for enterprise tenants.

claire-cs: I can notify top-20 tenants via our incident template. Standby for final phrasing.

ben-engineer: rollback complete on canary, running canary validation: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod-us-east1.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> 200 OK, latency improved. Rolling to remaining hosts.

infra-deploy-bot: deploy: rollback rollout 60% complete. Errors trending down in metrics.

maria-s: monitoring key metrics: 5xx down from 15% -> 1.4% over last 3m. Latency trending back to baseline. Marking mitigation effective.

ben-engineer: continuing monitoring, will keep rollback in place until postmortem. Will collect kernel metrics for root cause.

maria-s: incident owner: @maria-s. Oncall handoff: I'll keep incident active for 2h for monitoring, then hand to SRE followup rotation for postmortem.

sre_pager: Acknowledged. Pager cleared for immediate escalation; followup owner noted.

claire-cs: sending email to affected tenants now + posting status page update as drafted.

infra-alert-bot: Incident severity: P1. Warroom link pinned. Next update in 15 minutes or on significant state change.
